observation.visible_scene: A vertical press-like assembly is centered in frame: a cylindrical head marked with yellow-and-black diagonal stripes sits above a polished circular metal plate, and a matching lower metal plate rests on a workbench. Between the plates is a pink-and-purple spiky ball. The background is a green wall with two yellow warning signs.
visible_changes: The upper plate and striped cylinder move downward throughout the segment, while the lower plate remains stationary.
The ball is progressively compressed vertically: its height decreases as the gap between the plates narrows.
The ball expands laterally as it is squashed, becoming a wider flattened disc and bulging outward beyond the diameter of the lower plate in later frames.
The ball's spiky surface texture becomes less pronounced as compression increases.
The rate of visible deformation slows near the end, with the ball remaining as a thin compressed layer between the plates.
The background and lower plate positions stay fixed, indicating the main motion is the descending upper assembly and the ball's deformation rather than camera movement.
outside_clip_unknowns: What happened before the first frame, including the ball's original uncompressed shape or how the press was activated, is not shown.
What happens after the last frame, such as release, rebound, rupture, or continued compression, is not visible.
The cause of the press motion and any operator or machine control are outside the clip.
uncertain_details: The exact material of the ball cannot be determined from the frames alone.
It is uncertain whether the ball is already slightly compressed at the very first frame or just before full contact.
Minor apparent vibration or camera jitter is not clearly distinguishable from object motion.
